t: GoGaRuCo 2012 - Sugar-Free Ruby: An Experiment in Object-first Teaching by Steven! Ragnarok

q.x: Whether it's appropriate to start with an OO language I guess is another question, but I think done the right way, starting with OO isn't as hard as people think. [1] [link]

desc: Ruby has a lot of syntax to come to terms with. In an effort to reduce learning overhead we often restrict what we teach by avoiding serious coverage of objects in early lessons. Yet objects are what make Ruby great.
